topic: Human Reproductive System Parts and Functions
key_concepts: The human life cycle includes fetus, baby/infant, childhood, adolescent/teenager, adulthoo
Reproduction is the process by which organisms replicate themselves.
The reproductive system is the group of body parts that work together for reproduction.
Fertilization is the union of a sperm and an egg to form an embryo.
The female reproductive system includes the ovaries, uterus, and vagina.
Ovaries produce egg cells and hormones such as estrogen and progesterone.
The uterus is a hollow, pear-shaped organ where a fetus develops and grows.
The vagina receives sperm and is part of the birth canal.
The male reproductive system includes the prostate, testis, and penis.
The penis passes semen out of the body and contains the urethra.
The prostate gland produces prostatic fluid that aids ejaculation.
